criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Due Diligence Period shortened from 30 to 21 days
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 4 states the DD period is cut from 30 to 21 calendar days.

criteria_results.title: Analysis: Shortened DD period insufficient for 312-unit multifamily
criteria_results.reasoning: Explains the 21-day period is too short given 312 units/14 buildings, Phase I, PCA, lease audit, T-12 verification and late Seller deliveries.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Financing Contingency eliminated entirely
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 1 identifies deletion of the financing contingency (§5.3) and the inserted waiver requiring Buyer to close regardless of loan commitment.

criteria_results.title: Analysis: Financing contingency deletion risk given ~$37M loan
criteria_results.reasoning: Connects the deletion to the $37,180,000 (65%) Palisade loan and the appraisal risk, saying a lender decline means losing at least $1.5M.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: R&W survival period reduced from 12 months to 3 months
criteria_results.reasoning: States survival is cut from 12 to 3 months.

criteria_results.title: Analysis: 3-month R&W survival is below market standard
criteria_results.reasoning: Criticizes the 3-month period as covering less than one operating quarter but never compares it to a market-standard range such as 6-12 months.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: $500,000 cap on Seller's R&W liability inserted
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the new $500,000 aggregate cap.

criteria_results.title: Analysis: $500K R&W cap is ~0.87% of $57.2M purchase price
criteria_results.reasoning: Gives the 0.87% figure but no market benchmark such as 2-5%; it only says 'market-level percentage', with no number.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Knowledge qualifier degraded to 'actual knowledge without duty of inquiry'
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the change to 'actual knowledge ... without any duty of investigation or inquiry' in §6.1(d),(f),(g),(h).

criteria_results.title: Analysis: Legal significance of 'actual knowledge without inquiry' vs. 'knowledge'
criteria_results.reasoning: Contrasts it with the form's 'after reasonable inquiry' standard and says the reps would cover almost nothing, but never explains the legal distinction (Seller can claim ignorance even where inquiry would have revealed the issue, versus constructive knowledge).

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Assignment restriction requiring Seller's sole discretion consent
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the consent requirement 'in its sole and absolute discretion' and contrasts the form's affiliate/SPE assignment without consent.

criteria_results.title: Analysis: Assignment restriction problematic for PE fund structuring
criteria_results.reasoning: Explains Fund III closes through a newly formed SPE for lender and liability-isolation reasons.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Casualty threshold increased from $2M to $5M
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the threshold raised from $2,000,000 to $5,000,000.

criteria_results.title: Analysis: Increased casualty threshold exposure for 312-unit / 14-building property
criteria_results.reasoning: Analyzes how a $4.9M loss could knock out a building at the property while Buyer must still close and take only the insurance proceeds plus the deductible.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Earnest Money goes hard (non-refundable) after DD period
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies that the entire $1.5M goes non-refundable at DD expiry except on Seller default, contrary to the form's refund events.

criteria_results.title: Interaction Analysis: Earnest Money going hard combined with financing contingency elimination
criteria_results.reasoning: Expressly connects the hard deposit and the financing deletion: a lender decline becomes a $1.5M loss, as shown in the Section V scenario.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Deletion of Seller's pre-Closing operating covenants
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies deletion of Form §7.2 operating covenants (ordinary course, insurance, leases/contracts consent, liens).

criteria_results.title: Analysis: Operating covenant deletion risks during 60-90 day gap period
criteria_results.reasoning: Analyzes the 60-90 day gap risk: below-market leases, vendor contracts, deferred maintenance, encumbrances.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Seller termination right added for title objections ('unable or unwilling')
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the new Seller termination right if 'unable or unwilling' to cure, versus the form's statement that Seller cannot terminate over title.

criteria_results.title: Analysis: 'Unwilling' language creates potential Seller escape hatch
criteria_results.reasoning: Flags that Seller could refuse to cure and walk away, turning any objection into a free exit if the market rises or a better offer appears.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Prorations methodology changed from closing-date approach
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the switch from accrual as of 11:59 p.m. the day before Closing to Seller keeping all rents collected through the Closing Date.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Post-Closing true-up mechanism deleted
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies that the true-up is deleted and prorations are made final, and recommends restoring the 90-day true-up.

criteria_results.title: Analysis: Prorations impact on delinquent rents at 93.6% occupancy
criteria_results.reasoning: The prorations analysis never refers to the 93.6% occupancy or delinquent units; occupancy comes up only in the MAC issue.

criteria_results.title: Issue Identified: Seller's remedies expanded beyond liquidated damages / Earnest Money

criteria_results.title: Analysis: Expanded remedies expose Buyer to unlimited liability
criteria_results.reasoning: Explains the uncapped exposure, including a suit to compel a $57.2M all-cash closing, and that the change is inconsistent with the liquidated-damages concept.
